facts.fact: Burkina Faso's Open Government Partnership commitment no. 2 commits the state to digitalising the system that registers civil-status acts and to creating secondary civil-status centres in all health centres, with activities scheduled from 2023-01-01 to 2025-06-30; it names no software, and the date used is the document's published date, which is the start of that schedule.

The document also states that insecurity destroyed the registers of 532 civil-status centres and that the national mean access radius to a centre is 7.80 km, neither dated.
